explore.title: Beyond the River Calchaquí
explore.hint: Move the pointer. Hover over elements to inspect. Click to interact.

narrative.rock_hover: A smooth stone by the path.
narrative.rock_inspect: A smooth stone, polished by the wind. There are carved marks you cannot decipher.
narrative.tree_inspect: A dry algarrobo. Its shade shelters stones someone stacked with care.
narrative.ruin_inspect: Adobe walls that time brought down. Someone lived here; now only dust remains.
narrative.coquena_hover: A hunched figure by the fire.
narrative.coquena_inspect: Coquena, the merchant and protector deity. Watches you without haste.

coquena_greeting.l1_coquena: You came far, little one. The river is not crossed with hunger, but with wit.
coquena_greeting.l3_coquena: I do not understand you, but I know you. The spirit that guides you… is also familiar to me.
coquena_greeting.l5_coquena: If you wish to cross, you will need more than courage. Search the riverbank.
